steps.name: plan
steps.prompt: Create /tmp/jcode-rack-test/PIPELINE_PLAN.txt containing exactly PLAN_READY. Then read the file and reply with exactly COMPLETE.

steps.name: implement
steps.prompt: Create /tmp/jcode-rack-test/PIPELINE_OUTPUT.txt containing exactly PIPELINE_OK. Then read the file and reply with exactly COMPLETE.

steps.name: verify
steps.prompt: Read /tmp/jcode-rack-test/PIPELINE_OUTPUT.txt. Then create /tmp/jcode-rack-test/PIPELINE_VERIFY.txt containing exactly VERIFIED_OK. Then read that file and reply with exactly COMPLETE.
